description: This file contains a PHP class `Comment` in the namespace `Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Cms`. The class extends a system engine controller and manages CRUD operations related to comments in the CMS module of an OpenCart project. It includes methods for listing, viewing, replying to, adding, and rating comments, along with handling comment-related data and interactions such as pagination, sorting, captcha verification, and session management.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class managing CMS comments, including listing, replying, and rating comments within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the comment interface, including fetching article ID, sorting, pagination, login status, and captcha setup, then rendering the 'cms/comment' view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Should output comments list; responds with the retrieved list of comments via controller_cms_comment.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches a list of comments for a specified article, including sorting, pagination, and generating URLs for actions like like/dislike, reply, and add comment.

methods.name: getReplies
methods.description: Retrieves replies to a particular comment, including nested replies and pagination for replies.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Outputs replies for a particular comment, likely in JSON for AJAX consumption.

methods.name: getReplies
methods.description: Fetches replies to a specific comment with pagination, returning an HTML view.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a new comment, including validating captcha, permissions, and inserting data into the database.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Handles rating actions on comments or comments' replies, including parsing inputs, validation, updating ratings, and returning JSON responses.
